standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3601-3604) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the statement for algebraic spaces to which the proof reduces.

core_obligations: Choose the covers: the proof picks a smooth cover of the base and a smooth cover of the fibre product of the middle stack with it, and forms the fibre product of the latter with the source (proof lines 3595-3598)

Read off the properties: by the hypotheses the resulting map of algebraic spaces is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, and its composite to the base cover is locally of finite type (proof lines 3599-3600)
Reduce to spaces: the assertion for stacks therefore follows from the corresponding descent statement for algebraic spaces, quoted at the end (proof lines 3601-3604)
proof_roadmap: 取满光滑 W → Z、V → W ×_Z Y，令 U = V ×_Y X（是代数空间）。由假设 U → V 满、平坦、局部有限表现，且 U → W 局部有限型。
于是断言化归到代数空间的相应命题，即跨章的下降引理（沿着 U → V 这类覆盖下降「局部有限型」）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a composite of morphisms of algebraic stacks the second factor is locally of finite type as soon as the composite is locally of finite type and the first factor is representable, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 3585-3592, label lemma-check-finite-type-precompose). The proof (source lines 3594-3605) chooses smooth covers, reads the required properties off the induced morphism of algebraic spaces and reduces to the corresponding descent statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 3595-3604). The reduction through the covers is the content. H2.
